title: Chapter 716: Respond With Troops
content:
Chapter 716: Respond With Troops

In the courtyard of the eldest son's residence, the moonlight in the sky faded and disappeared, and the face of the eldest son Fusu also dimmed and brightened accordingly, making Dong Gong, Meng Tianfang, and Shao Ping a little confused. They always felt that the eldest son in front of them was actually So strange.

How could Fusu, who had always been loyal and filial, secretly instigate Mo to assassinate the emperor? This was treason. A son would kill his father, and a minister would kill his king!

Fortunately, before Dong Gong's belief in "righteousness" collapsed, Fusu finally began to explain the whole story:

"Gentlemen, Fusu has never thought of killing his father!"

He and several of his subordinates revealed the plan that had been planned for more than half a year.

"Last year, I was overjoyed when I saw my father exiled the legal officials. I could no longer listen to any good advice. Before the Southern Expedition was over, I wanted to go west again. Regardless of the chaos in the world and the people's dire livelihood, I had to spend huge amounts of manpower and money to find Daxia. I can't help but feel chilled by the envoy's fabrication of the Kingdom of the Queen Mother of the West. A king must remonstrate with his ministers when he has a fault, and a son must correct his faults when his father has faults. Fusu dare not sit idly by and watch."

"However, my father is extremely arrogant and can't listen to any good advice. Fusu has no choice but to come up with a solution..."

He looked at the three of them and said those two words.

"King of Tribulation!"

The so-called robbery of the king, as the name suggests, is to kidnap the monarch by force. Similar things have been done countless times by the officials in the Spring and Autumn Period. The most recent time was during the reign of King Qi Min. The nobleman Tian Jia suddenly launched a coup, led hundreds of clan soldiers into the palace, and kidnapped King Qi Min.

It is said that this coup was caused by the Mengchang monarch, who wanted to rely on holding the King of Qi hostage to continue to maintain his position.

"How can this be so!"

Dong Gong was a little angry, and he banged his dove stick and said: "The father has made mistakes, and the son should rebuke him. How can he secretly commit illegal acts and be called unfilial? Isn't the old man's plan for the son to be respectful and filial, to be patient and wait?"

Anyone with a discerning eye can see that none of Qin Shihuang's disciples are very outstanding now. Once the mountains collapse, the position of emperor will not belong to Fu Su? What I fear most at this time is the unforeseen complications. How can I make trouble for myself? How confusing!

"Mr. Dong, have you forgotten the sun during the day?"

Fusu had his own ideas. He sighed: "Today's politics is like ten days in the sky. The crops are scorched, the vegetation is killed, and there are almost no survivors left!"

"Fusu loves his father and hopes that he can live forever, but he also hopes that he can stop these tyranny immediately. The more this continues, the less his father will be able to become a saint king, and the Qin Dynasty will not be able to be passed down for eternity. Maybe the second generation will die. Dead!"

"In order to prevent his father from continuing to issue arbitrary orders and make mistakes, Fusu was willing to bear the reputation of being unfaithful and unfilial, hijack it, and then ask his father to rule from the side and let the world recuperate. This may be why Fusu can Think of it, the best way to show your filial piety!"

This kind of brain circuit is a bit strange, and everyone is stunned.

Although he had the idea of "robbing the king", most of Fusu's old troops who conquered Haidong were not around. There were only a hundred soldiers as guards of the mansion. Apart from the 200,000 prisoners in Afang Palace, the only available weapons were those with He is a kind-hearted Mohist.

The prisoners were a mob, and Fusu did not dare to use them easily. Like Lord Yangcheng of Chu, he hoped that the Mo family could become his helper, so he found Tang Duo and revealed the plan...

Meng Tianfang was a little indignant: "Why did you tell Mo Zhe, but didn't say a word to us? Could it be that you don't trust us, and you don't trust Meng?"

Fusu explained: "That's not the case. It's just that if the king doesn't keep it secret, his ministers will lose. If the minister doesn't keep it secret, he will lose his virginity. If a few things are not kept secret, it will cause harm. Fusu doesn't want everyone to be involved in this matter... Once it is exposed, more will be involved. people."

But Duke Dong was concerned about another point: "Sir, do you really just want to rob the king, not assassinate him?"

Fusu raised his hand and pointed at Haoyue: "Fusu can swear to heaven that he will never kill his father!"

Dong Gong sighed: "I know that the young master is a kind man and will not do any treason."

He was a learned old man, and he immediately found an excuse for Fusu: "At the beginning, Chu officials wanted to remonstrate with King Chu Wen with fists, but King Chu Wen refused to obey; when he faced him with troops, he followed him out of fear. "Zuo Shi" thought Fighting with fist soldiers to remonstrate is an act of love for the emperor, and a son who wants to rob your majesty and remonstrates with him is also an act of loving his father and respecting his emperor..."

"Even though some people may say that the young master is unfaithful and unfilial, so what? If you accept the filth of the country, you are called the master of the country; if you accept the bad luck of the country, you are the king of the world!"

"Lord of Sheji, King of the World!" The other two people also shouted. This is their expectation for Fusu!

Dong Gong's baptism is good, but it's a pity that although he was infected by the black husband and turned slightly black, Fusu is Fusu.

When Qin Shihuang inspected Afang Palace, he had the opportunity to kidnap Qin Shihuang, but he was frightened by the meteor shower in the sky and thought it was a warning from heaven, so he hesitated for a while.

After all, there are too few examples of King Jie's success. Even Tian Jia, under the siege of King Qin's troops and Linzi residents who came after hearing the news, quickly gave up resistance. After releasing King Qi Min, he announced his abandonment of Jia Surrendered and was executed.

He decided to wait and see.

But what Fusu never expected was that Mo Zhe had his own doctrines and plans. Tang Duo and others turned "King of Robbery" into "King of Punishment!" hoping to get it right in one step and support Fusu on the throne. , but accidentally, he lost everything!

Now, the Mohist's intention to assassinate the emperor has been exposed, and more than a hundred Mohists in Xianyang, whether they knew it or not, were all arrested!

After being shocked, Mr. Dong fell into deep thought: "Even if Tang Duo gritted his teeth and didn't say a word after being arrested, given the relationship between the young master and Mo Zhe, there will definitely be a traitor who will lead the matter to the young master!"

"That's right. After all, it's a crime to kill the Qin Dynasty. They can create this kind of thing out of nothing. So what's the difficulty in accusing me of regicide and rebellious son?"

Fusu gritted his teeth. Heifu's secret letter was too shocking. He hadn't shown it to his subordinates yet, but judging from the warning given to him by Brother Mengtian, there might really be an "evil person on your side" plotting secretly!

What's even more troublesome is that Fusu is indeed the mastermind behind Mo Zhe. Once the case expands, he thinks that there is no possibility of him being cleared up!

"What will happen if Your Majesty suspects the young master?"

This question raised by Shaoping made Fusu shudder.

In his impression, his father is a person who hates betrayal the most, and he believes in Han Feizi's set of emperor-subject-father-son relationship:

"Human beings are babies, and if their parents raise them poorly, the son will grow up and complain; if the child grows into a mature man, his support will be poor, and his parents will be angry and scold him. The son and the father are the closest relatives, and those who are either arrogant or resentful, they all rely on each other to do nothing. Zhou Yu is doing it for himself; if he is thinking about harming him, the father and son will be separated and resentful."

Everything is a relationship of interest, and even the relationship between father and son cannot escape this iron law of human nature.

Due to the change of interests, as an emperor, even the wives, concubines and children around him may be put to death for his own interests!

For example, King Mu of Chu killed his father with his son, killed King Cheng of Chu, committed fratricide, and fought against each other. There are countless similar examples in history!

Fusu secretly thought: "If my father knew that I wanted to rob the government of the Republic of China and completely overthrow the government of the Republic of China, he would be extremely angry, right?"

Then, there was ruthless arrest, interrogation, and even killing...

Just like Nang Pu killed the two brothers born of the same mother to Queen Mother Zhao and Lao Ai!

This may not be Qin Shihuang's real reaction, but it is what Fusu imagined his ruthless and determined father would do...

How many sons can put themselves in their father’s shoes? Not to mention guessing their true reaction to something.

Pretend not to know and get away with it? Fusu didn't take any chances. Qin Shihuang was old and dim, but he was extremely sensitive to power struggles. This can be seen from the arrangements he arranged for the black husband.

Fusu only felt that when the time came, his father would only need to look at him to see through his son's shallow tricks.

There is no way to appeal. Could he still argue: "I just asked Mo Zhe to find an opportunity to cooperate with me in kidnapping my father, not to kill my father with one sword"?

In short, from Fusu's point of view, everything is over, and the expectations and waits of him and his subordinates will be destroyed in one day. There is no need to think about inheriting the throne. Even if you are lucky enough to survive, you will still be imprisoned and secluded...

If I had known this, why did I do it in the first place?

If Fusu had been replaced, he might have committed suicide, or he might have put down his sword, calmly been bound, and obeyed Qin Shihuang's orders.

But now, the words in Heifu's letter, "Never sit back and wait for death" have been echoing in his mind.

At this time, Shaoping came up with an idea: "Master, before the matter is revealed, it's still too late to leave Xianyang..."

Yes, leaving is indeed a way. Fusu remembered Heifu's letter, which advised him to join the Northern and Southern armies if something happened.

Now that the Northern Army has changed its generals, it is impossible to move, but the Southern Army...

"How can we run away? It will be considered as a guilty conscience, and it will prove that the young master wants to kill your majesty! By then, any of the pavilion chiefs and minor officials can tie up the young master and take him back to Xianyang with an arrest warrant! "

Mengtian shouted loudly to stop him, and then he bowed down and said, "Now that things have come to a close, there is still another way!"

"What can we do?" Fusu asked him. Hei Fu was far away in the south, Mengshi. This was his last support in Xianyang.

Meng Tianfang said: "Since the young master has decided to do the right thing even if he is accused of being unfaithful and unfilial by the people in the world, why not do it to the end?"

"you mean……"

Meng Tianfang raised his head. Meng Tian's clan brother had determination in his eyes:

"Tian Fang is willing to serve as the prince's envoy to lobby General Meng. With 10,000 guards and 200,000 prisoners, he can break into the palace, defeat thousands of soldiers, kidnap your majesty, and clean up the king's side. The evil ones should be punished with troops!"
